paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges that the Owner holds the utility interconnection agreements and secures the campus permits. The proposer will provide the necessary equipment data, studies, and drawings required by the Owner for these applications, adhering to the Owner's program.

The proposer confirms that no entity subject to applicable sanctions or restrictive measures is involved in this tender in any capacity. All group companies, subcontractors, and key suppliers are screened against the relevant sanction lists before being included in the tender.

The proposer treats all information exchanged during the bid process as confidential and uses it solely for the preparation of this tender. Access to this information is restricted to the designated bid team members, and any subcontractors involved are bound by the same confidentiality obligations.
